docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: CAPTCHA stands for Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart. It is a security mechanism designed to distinguish between human users and automated bots on the internet.

docs.title: Why CAPTCHA Exists
docs.text:
• Websites are constantly targeted by automated programs (bots) that:
  • Create fake accounts
  • Send spam messages
  • Scrape data
  • Perform brute-force attacks
  • To protect against these threats, CAPTCHAs provide small tests that are easy for humans but hard for machines.

docs.title: Key Characteristics
docs.text:
• Automated generation and grading: The system must be able to automatically create the challenge and verify the solution.
  • Asymmetry: The task should be solvable by a human with minimal effort, but require significant resources for a bot.
  • Accessibility considerations: CAPTCHAs must remain usable for people with disabilities (e.g., offering audio alternatives).

Next: We’ll explore the History of CAPTCHA, from its invention in the early 2000s to modern reCAPTCHA.
